value.rationale: A² over pure equality is the simplest nominal object with two distinct transitive orbits and is a standard test case for quotient/imaginary constructions. The full classification isolates two mathematically different finite exceptional mechanisms (third-atom equivariant selector at n=3 and complementary 2-set quotient at n=4), proves sharp stabilization at five, and yields a nonmonotone exact spectrum not implied by simply counting pair orbits. The proof is structural, not an arbitrary parameter slice, and offers an exact benchmark for orbit-finite quotient semantics.
